items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: Those little troops with Dizzy and Roy and starting out with Nat Cole and Oscar Peterson later and then Ella and Flip Phillips, Jo Jones, Gene Krupa and Buddy Rich. Ray Brown. That carried the banner of jazz all over the world.

ctx.x: Sure. I remember Ray Brown used to say don't teach anybody who played bass with an amplifier on it, he's got to learn to play it so he can make his own
power first, before anything else, and what he does later with it is his own business.
